policy.denominator: Every confirmed political/dependent/composite occurrence plus explicitly pending political/variant candidates. Protected community/geographic occurrences stay outside. Pending eligibility is reported separately; this is a conservative assessment denominator, not a claim that every candidate is a state.
policy.empty: No supported substantive historical category; title and mapped geometry alone do not prevent the empty QA trigger.
policy.availability: Old entity-level any-year resolver availability remains a legacy diagnostic only; never completion.
policy.qualifications: A qualified composite region need not have one ruler/capital. Missing is never silently N/A. Historical uncertainty requires evidence.
